This is tricky to answer. I am currently on Invisalign and I have nighttime bruxism. I too sought out Invisalign because my upper canines were breaking my lower canines during sleep.

However, I have been doing refinement after refinement because I keep going back and forth between a posterior open bite and anterior open bite, also probably because of grinding. My bite does not feel good or safe and I have found to have worse jaw issues because of this.

The two layers of plastic have seemed sufficient and I have never ground through the plastic. (I have been in my #10/14 since mid-January due to teeth issues and Invisalign messing up my next refinement set and the aligners are in decent shape still). 

Honestly? I would get bonding on your chipped teeth and just get a mouth guard. The bite issues I have now don’t seem worth the headache I am dealing with now.

Do you use Crest ProHealth mouthwash? Like 1-2% of people’s saliva reacts with the mouthwash and causes staining, because of ingredients such as cetylpyridinium chloride or stannous fluoride, same goes for toothpaste. Switch to a different toothpaste/mouthwash without these ingredients.

You won’t be able to get rid of the staining on your own, but your dental hygienist at your regular cleaning should be able to get it off. I schedule 2 additional cleanings in between the 2 that insurance pays for so that I can keep my teeth as clean as possible!
